title: CVE-2022-30954 (blue_ocean)
summary: Jenkins Blue Ocean Plugin 1.25.3 and earlier does not perform a permission check in several HTTP endpoints, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to connect to an attacker-specified HTTP server.

Description
Jenkins Blue Ocean Plugin 1.25.3 and earlier does not perform a permission check in several HTTP endpoints, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to connect to an attacker-specified HTTP server.
